外 形 寸 法 : 幅 60mm X 奥行 き 190mm x 高 さ 78.7mm
64DD を NINTENDO 64 以 外 に 接続 し な いで くだ さい 。
ディ スク の 挿入 口 で す 。
イジ ェクト ボタ ン (EJECT) / ボタ ン を 押す と ディ スク が 取り 出せ ます 。

notes: Scan of Nintendo's Japanese 64DD (NUS-010(JPN)) 取扱説明書, file 'Nintendo 64DD (Japanese)' in archive.org item 64dd-manuals; every quote is that scan's Japanese OCR text layer, which inserts spaces between characters. The item's English file is a fan translation and is not used.

DIMENSIONS: the 仕様 line reads '外 形 寸 法 : 幅 60mm X 奥行 き 190mm x 高 さ 78.7mm'. Depth 190 and height 78.7 read cleanly and are filed; the WIDTH is OCR-damaged (the 64DD sits under a 260 mm-wide console, and the same OCR misreads the N64's 260 as 'e60'), so width stays null pending a human read of the scan. Excludes-projections not stated: null.

features: role 'addon' and host_console 'nintendo-64' from '64DD を NINTENDO 64 以外に接続しないでください' (do not connect the 64DD to anything but the NINTENDO 64); the manual also says it is powered from the NINTENDO 64 (使用電源 ... NUS-001(JPN) より供給), so no power inlet of its own (power_inlet left null rather than inventing a value).
media: the front-panel 'ディスク挿入口' (disk insertion slot) → disc_slot 1. The 64DD disk is a magnetic disk in a cartridge-like shell, not an optical disc; the §3 vocabulary has no closer kind.
controls: the 各部の名称 front panel lists ACCESS lamp, disk slot and EJECT button → eject_button 1. The rear/underside connector to the NINTENDO 64 has no §3 port kind; ports stay uncovered.
external_ids: Wikidata Q253044 ('64DD', Nintendo 64 add-on); that item carries two P5795 values ('nintendo-64dd', '64dd'), so igdb_platform is left null rather than picking one.
